sourceFile: 54. BRS-201506 Report checking and test problem NG function high date 14.6.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not reliable because it overgroups unrelated workbook sections into one ambiguous changed factor.
issues: Changed factor mixes many unrelated conditions and domains.
Baseline and test conditions are not traceable to one comparison.
Outcomes combine separate reports, process checks, function tests, and dimensions.
Several measurement stats are nonsensical or parsed from headers/counts.
Review title and purpose do not match the cited primary evidence.
requiredUserQuestions: Which workbook section is the intended primary review case?
Should coil offset/JIG investigation be separate from frame size and VP tests?
correctionPlan: Identify one primary changed-condition context per report section.
Rebuild baseline and changed conditions from adjacent headers and row labels.
Split unrelated domains into separate review cases or exclude them.
Remove bogus measurement stats and header-derived metrics.
Cite header, data, and decision rows for each retained outcome.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are insufficient because grouping context and cited meanings are unreliable.
